items.english: Then a fierce dizziness came on, two or three times running. The headache had not let up since some time before. In his heart Liu resented the barbarian monk more and more. And he thought, too, why a man such as himself should have let himself be talked round by such a fellow into bearing such witless suffering. Meanwhile his throat grew thirstier still. His chest turned strangely queasy. He could no longer bear to lie still. At last, resolved, he opened his panting mouth, meaning to ask the barbarian monk at his pillow to call the cure off. —

At that very instant. Liu began to feel some unnameable lump creeping little by little from his chest up toward his throat. At one moment it seemed to writhe like an earthworm, at another to edge itself along little by little like a gecko. In any case, a soft thing, soft as it was, came squirming and pressing its way up the gullet. And at last, when it had forced its way past below the Adam's apple, it suddenly slipped out of the dark, slimy like a loach or something, and flew outwards with force.
With that, from the familiar unglazed jar, there came a faint plip, as of something dropping into the wine.
At that the barbarian monk suddenly lifted the haunches he had settled and began to undo the thin cord wound about Liu's body. The wine worm was out, he said, so Liu might set his mind at rest.

data.say: Drafted the expulsion in flat bodily register with the low animal similes kept plain.
